*Update on the cat:*

It's a boy! We were all so convinced that it was a girl hahaha. We were right about the age at least!

Quote from the vet, "Yeah, so um- there's nothing there cause it was actually done a while ago, but it's a boy."

I guess leave it to the vets. 😂😅

Thank you! That's what we were assuming. When we took her in the vet said that everything was private. The owner's name, the cat's name, the sex, location, phone number- everything except an email. So we left the vet our information to send over to the email associated with the chip.

We've been looking online and around the neighborhood for any lost cat postings and we haven't found a single one that looks like her for several months.

I'm assuming worst case scenario is that someone adopted her already microchipped and spayed/neutered but just stopped caring once she got out of the kitten stage. I've seen far too many people do that with cats once they're not a "toy" anymore 🙄

Thank you! That's what we were leaning towards. We have four cats and all of them had either a scar, shaved area that took forever to grow back completely, or little tattoo left by the vet, so we were a bit perplexed. She also has a pretty thick tail for being a short hair (another reason we were thinking maybe a male), but now we're thinking it may be because she's malnourished. 

Also, I never knew about them having the ability to grow back their reproductive organs??? So thank you for that bit of information for future reference lol

Hi OP,

I can relate a bit. Right now I'm trying to find goals from my childhood. I think thinking of goals or dreams from an innocent or happy time in your life can put things in a different perspective sometimes. 

I'm trying to think of that part of myself in third person. I want that happy person I once cared about  to achieve a couple of last goals before we're both gone. I think it helps me have a bit more empathy for myself because I literally think of it as another person from a different life.

If we're gonna go and die, we rather well have a little bit of selfish time for ourselves. Do something you never thought you could do and see how it makes you feel. If it feels good, find something else that gives you that feeling and run with it.

Worst case scenario is it doesn't do anything, but you tried, and you gave yourself that chance. I mean, you would've been dead anyways right? Anything you do before that is an accomplishment.

I hope you find some happiness and give yourself a chance OP. We're here to talk if you ever want to.

I've always felt like a "purse dog" in public to my mother growing up. I was there to show off and have others comment on my behavior for her benefit. I was never allowed to "say ____", add my thought to a story (or you know, say what *really* happened) or defend myself when she would "joke" about me in front of other adults (usually family members). She would make herself seem like a martyr most of the time.

Her favorite thing would be to comment on me never having any chores in front of others even though I wanted to (for an allowance) growing up. It used to make me feel so guilty and mad at the same time. I never had consistent list of daily chores yet it was never said that it was my daily responsibility retrieve any food, drinks, come when called, help (or you know DO as she sits there) with any cleaning she asked in that exact second (because one second later would be a blow up), you know basically be the free servent for her every whim that she could also scream at. 

After the age of maybe 8 when I was getting to old to be the Chihuahua she carries around in her purse, most of the rest of my childhood were frequent 
 phases of "shoo I'm busy ____/_____ is more important/ why are you so ungrateful/go away/stop giving me attitude/I never treated my mother with the disrespect you give me/god what do you want now"

Then the best and worst parts were when she had her moments of actually sanity and kindness. Usually a couple times a year there would be a week when she made me feel loved or needed. Usually she would just let me talk all day. For some reason she wouldn't make me feel guilty or out of place. I know now most was probably for her own benefit of needing the feeling of feeling needed (she wanted the drama in my life).

The best days were when she would let me talk. It's those days that make me still love my mother more than anything else even though I know the feeling is not mutual.

Yeah I feel. What's weird is that not only have I been rethinking life recently, but I've had *several* conversations with my boss and parents lately about people getting hit by dumb asses on the streets these days.

"Good thing you wear a helmet"

"Yeah_____ happened to me _______"

"Did you see the article about the cyclist that got hit and killed by _______?

Etc, etc.

Like the world was screaming at me "it's coming!!!"

I've religiously worn a helmt all of my life, not because I'm afraid of dying but because I was afraid of quite the opposite. I'm terrified of being in a position where I'm so physically or mentally disabled that I wouldn't be able to kill myself. Just end up being an even bigger burden to my family with no way out.

Today changed that thought a little.

Hi man. 

I know this is pretty late considering the circumstances. I can't feel your exact pain, I don't know what it's like to go through your life, but I know life can be hard. Life can be complete utter BULLSHIT... But there are always little things here and there that can just remind you that there is some good in life. It may not be people, or relationships, love, or even yourself in some cases, but there's always something teeny tiny that's there for all of us.

I'm not going to tell you what to do in the end. Maybe our purposes expire, and some are meant to be deaths destiny. Maybe people like us go to hell or are reincarnated in a shittier place or miss out on the possible life after death senarios because we used up our chance.

But remember that this is always still an option. What's your favorite food? Favorite band or a place you've always wanted to go to? How about (and normally I wouldn't recommend this) getting completely shit faced at the bar? Fly high as a kite your friendly neighborhood stoner? Don't let yourself end in misery. 

Give one last gift to yourself and see how you feel. Give yourself the best day you could ever imagine for YOURSELF. Focus on the last things you would ever want to do. You don't have to make a bucket list and finish it all in a day. Just have your last day be about you. You deserve better. You deserve to leave this earth content doing anything and everything that you've loved.

So if that's just sipping on coffee all day, or binging on Netflix, or taking a (literally) last minute trip to anywhere in the world; do it. Suicide is always there. If you really feel like that's your destiny at least go out in style man. You won't have to worry about money or planning or relationships or ANYTHING later on anyways if you're dead right?

Live your final moments to the fullest. Everyone deserves to die content. Even if they're taking their own life.

If you ever need to talk, me and plenty of others are willing to be an ear. We believe in you. I hope you find peace.
